title: Restriction of a measure representation to a set is a current (Simon 6.2.9)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P and v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) k such that x ↦ v(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable for every ω ∈ D^k(U), μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x, α. Then for every A ⊆ ℝ^P there is S ∈ D_k(U) with S(ω) = ∫_A v(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω ∈ D^k(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Integrable (fun x => v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x)) μ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U k, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, S ω = ∫ x in A, v x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ∂μ
